name: fighter
description: A twin-engine jet fighter: a blended fuselage with leading-edge extensions, raked side intakes, a bubble canopy (hinged at its rear edge) over an ejection seat and instrument coaming, trapezoid wings with ailerons and wingtip missiles, canted twin fins with rudders, all-moving tailplanes, two nozzles, formation and nav lights and tricycle landing gear with doors.
